title: Code
description: Code blocks, inline code and tabs.
---

Code is set in Consolas, or the nearest monospace face, a little smaller than
the text. Inline code such as `len(xs)` has no box around it, only its face.

## A code block

A block has a faint tint and a thin rule at its left. The colours of the
syntax follow Quarto's, and change with the mode.

```python
def sparkline(values: list[float], width: int = 100) -> list[tuple[float, float]]:
    "The points of a sparkline: x from 0 to width, y from 0 to 1."
    lo, hi = min(values), max(values)
    step = width / (len(values) - 1)
    return [(i * step, (v - lo) / (hi - lo or 1)) for i, v in enumerate(values)]
```
